Rosedale Lakes Endocrine Centre November 20, 2063
To whom it may concern / Kestrel Bakehouse Attn: Human Resources
Dear Mrs Marsh, Dear [PATIENT],
Re: Ngozi Adebayo-Marsh, DOB 09/03/2008, employee # KB-2210
I am writing at the patient's request. Ms. Adebayo-Marsh is a 55 year old baker whom I have followed since 2060. She has well controlled asthma, hyperlipidemia, prediabetes and a history of a heart attack in October 2061. She is stable and fit to work.
I recommend: (1) she avoid prolonged exposure to flour dust where possible, a mask during mixing; (2) she carry her albuterol inhaler at all times; (3) shifts of no more than 8 hours. Her labs from 11/13/2063 were reasonable. She was also seen by the dentist on the 20th, so please excuse her from work that day.
There is no need to contact her family, her mother Chinwe Adebayo lives overseas and has no role in her care.
Yours sincerely,
Priyanka Venkataraman, MD Endocrinology cc: pt; Samuel Achterberg, fax (416) 555-0142 Electronically signed 11/20/2063 09:31
